query: public description plus declared source basenames, full identifier and camel split, shared stop list
ranking: BM25 weights problem=3 code=2 benchmark=1; lower raw score first; performance numbers never indexed
lexical_gate: at least one exact target class or two informative query terms; exploratory, not gold-calibrated
isolation: all known official answer commits/PR-risk flags/families/normalized identical production patches; answer SHA references (7..40 hex) and explicit official PR citations in title/message/patch/parent also excluded; per-task same canonical target production files quarantined
known_PR_registry_source: frozen known-answer registry from knowledge build, retained in source archive
isolation_limit: conservative file scope (including module moves), not reliable method/semantic equivalence analysis; may exclude useful references
eligible_material: functional-pass evidence, nonmissing production patch; unreviewed load relations explicitly labeled, not treated as proven causal optimization
rendering: one complete production hunk per card; discard oversized card before indexing; count all exclusions; never trim a hunk or select by outcome
dedup: family and same full hunk without line-position header, deterministic tie by card insertion ID
total_budget: actual context including REFERENCE labels; reduce ranked prefix count if needed, never skip a higher-ranked eligible card to fit a lower-ranked one
random: same isolated pool, fixed-seed families uniformly sampled then card within family; match count and total card bytes within 10%
